Principle 21: Introduction
My name is James. I am 12 years old and am in the fifth grade.
I go to Han -guk Elementary School. I live in Seoul.
I am a very outgoing person, and I have a lot of friends.
My hobbies include reading books, listening to music
and watching movies. My favorite subject is English.
I like to help other people. When I help others, it makes me happy.
I have a nice family. There are 4 people in my family :
my father, my mother, my sister, and me.
My parents always make my sister and I feel important and special.
My sister attends Han-guk Elementary School.
She likes all kinds of animals.
My family is always happy, and we are very close to one another.
I am very outgoing, so I like to do many things with other people.
My best friend is Mary. She is like me in many ways.
She is also very outgoing but he is shier than I am.
She has many talents like speaking English and playing computer games.
She sometimes tells me that she wants to be an interpreter someday.
She is smart, and I am sure that her dream will come true.
I have many relatives because both my father and mother
have many brothers and sisters.
My uncles and aunts are all married, so I have a lot of cousins as well.
My favorite relative is my oldest uncle.
My family visits him twice a month.
He has children who are similar in age to me.
When we get together, we usually go out for dinner.
